truncation_rule: frame = engine.inputs.build_features(pit_basis='release', pit_as_of=d).loc[:d]; last index must be <= d; producers read the last row

history_legend.read: owner produced a non-null leaf at the date; the composer read it
history_legend.owner_null: owner produced its guarded null for the leaf at the date (the composer reads it as missing/owner_default_on_missing)
history_legend.partial_history: owner read from a reduced source set at the date (labour: 2 of 3 votes; Indeed IHLIDXUS begins 2020-02)
history_legend.insufficient_history: no stored history for the owner's sources at the date (labour: <=1 of 3 votes); read withheld, never approximated
history_legend.not_in_replay: letter outside the R-I replay (L/B/D/C) or field not assembled by the replay
history_legend.producer_error: owner decision function raised at the date
